'''Margarida "Maggy" Moreno Sánchez'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Moreno|Sánchez}} (born 3 April 1968) is an [[Andorra]]n [[track and field]] athlete who competed at the [[1992 Summer Olympics]].<ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/mo/maggy-moreno-1.html  |title=Maggy Moreno |access-date=2 December 2017 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203162103/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/mo/maggy-moreno-1.html |archive-date=3 December 2016 |quote=Full name: Margarida Moreno Sánchez}}</ref>

Moreno's first major competition was the [[1991 IAAF World Indoor Championships]] where she competed in the [[1991 IAAF World Indoor Championships – Women's high jump|high jump]]. Her jump of {{convert|1.75|m|abbr=off}} placed her in 26th place during the qualification stage and so she didn't qualify for the final.<ref>{{cite web |title=High Jump Women |url=https://www.iaaf.org/results/iaaf-world-indoor-championships/1991/3rd-iaaf-world-indoor-championships-15/women/high-jump/qualification/result#resultheader |website=iaaf.org |accessdate=2 December 2017}}</ref> Later in the year she also competed in the [[1991 World Championships in Athletics – Women's high jump|high jump]] at the [[1991 World Championships in Athletics]] in [[Tokyo]], she only managed to jump {{convert|1.70|m|abbr=off}} and again failed to reach the final.<ref>{{cite web |title=Women High Jump |url=https://www.iaaf.org/results/iaaf-world-championships-in-athletics/1991/3rd-iaaf-world-championships-in-athletics-5/women/high-jump/qualification/result#resultheader |website=iaaf.org |accessdate=2 December 2017}}</ref>

The following year Moreno was picked for the [[1992 Summer Olympics]], she was also chosen to be her country's flag bearer at the opening ceremony.<ref>{{cite web |title=Andorra |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/AND/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417093554/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/AND/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=17 April 2020 |website=Olympics at Sports-Reference.com |accessdate=2 December 2017}}</ref> In the [[Athletics at the 1992 Summer Olympics – Women's high jump|high jump]] she jumped {{convert|1.70|m|abbr=off}} and finished 41st so didn't qualify for the final.<ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1992/ATH/womens-high-jump.html |title=Athletics at the 1992 Barcelona Summer Games: Women's High Jump |access-date=2 December 2017 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417174256/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1992/ATH/womens-high-jump.html |archive-date=17 April 2020}}</ref>

Her personal bests in the event are 1.83 metres outdoors (Monzón 1991) and 1.81 metres indoors (San Sebastián 1990). Both are standing [[List of Andorran records in athletics|national records]].
